starts.rule: initial_innovations plus mu offsets, zero sigma offsets (WP4b rule); sspd-11 cold factor deliberately not applied; the same innovation-coordinate starts are mapped into v2 (a=1) and v3 coordinates

V2-A.role: secondary: refinement on the centered funnel

N3.role: external reference on the v3 density
